title: EzCrafting
description: Custom crafting recipes for your server!
body:
# EzCrafting

**EzCrafting** is a fast, lightweight, and powerful custom crafting plugin for Paper servers.

Create fully custom recipes using vanilla items or saved custom items directly from your server. EzCrafting preserves **NBT data**, **Custom Model Data**, display names, lore, enchantments, attributes, and others item metadata.

This allows recipes to work seamlessly with items created by other plugins and resource packs.

## Features

* Supports custom and vanilla crafting recipes.
* Preserves NBT and item metadata.
* Supports Custom Model Data and resource-pack items. _same as before_
* Compatible with items modified by other plugins.
* Lightweight and optimized for performance.
* Simple and user-friendly configuration system.

## Why EzCrafting?

Unlike many crafting plugins, EzCrafting can store and compare complete item data, including NBT, metadata, Custom Model Data, and plugin-specific information. This allows recipes to require exact custom items instead of only checking the vanilla material type.

Whether you're creating keys, custom tools, collectibles, or resource-pack based content, EzCrafting provides the flexibility you need.

## Compatibility

* Paper 1.21.4 - 26.1.2
* Java 21+

## Warning

**EzCrafting is currently in Alpha state.**

Features may change, bugs may be present, and configurations may require adjustments between updates. Please report any issues in the discord server to help improve the plugin.
